name: experienceOS
tagline: The operating system for experiential campaigns — campaigns, staffing, assets, lead capture, and reporting in one platform.
description:
experienceOS is B2B SaaS built for experiential agencies and live-event teams that outgrow spreadsheets and ad-hoc tools. The product unifies campaign planning, field staffing, asset inventory, on-site lead capture, dashboards, and client-ready reporting so national programs can run without a frankenstack of Airtable, decks, and manual ops.

The surface is multi-module: operators create campaigns and event timelines, assign shifts and roles, track branded assets, capture live engagement in the field, and turn that data into polished post-event reports — without rebuilding the same workflow for every activation.

coverImage.alt: experienceOS — experiential campaign operating system for agencies and live events

problem: Experiential agencies stitch together spreadsheets, Airtable bases, PowerPoint decks, and scattered docs. Staffing, assets, and lead data live in different places, real-time engagement is hard to see across events, and post-event reporting burns hours rebuilding the same client deliverable every time.
approach: Design one product around experiential workflows instead of forcing generic project software onto live events. Model campaigns as the spine, then attach staffing, assets, field data capture, and reporting as connected modules that share the same program context.
solution: A multi-module SaaS platform where teams create campaigns, configure ops, run activations with live capture, and generate client-ready reports from the same system of record. Dashboards and automated reporting replace one-off decks; field staff get web access without counting against admin seats.
features: Campaign management with locations, dates, and program timelines
Staffing and shift assignment with coverage tracking by event
Asset and inventory tracking with live utilization views
On-site lead and engagement capture for field teams
Real-time dashboards and automated post-event reporting
Scales from small agencies to multi-client enterprise programs
architecture: Multi-tenant B2B SaaS organized around campaign → event → ops modules. Shared program context feeds staffing, assets, field capture, and reporting so activations stay synchronized from setup through client delivery.
